notes: V7 adds Claude-essence editorial craft, LLM decision boundaries, manifest-first OpenMontage preflight, zero-key-first capability guidance, and Hermes runtime install/memory alignment.

evals.prompt: Make a Messi World Cup emotional legacy story video.
assertions: Output selects the Pain -> Pressure -> Comeback -> Legacy story structure, not a generic default
Output names a specific hook pattern from the emotion-pattern-library reference
Output does not fabricate specific match statistics not already known/verifiable
A user_instruction_profile-shaped output is produced with target_emotion set to legacy or comeback

evals.prompt: I want a video about a team that got humiliated and collapsed, like Brazil 2014.
assertions: Output selects a humiliation/collapse-oriented structure, not comeback or triumph
Output explicitly notes restraint is required (not edited like a hype reel)
No claim that this is a comeback story

evals.prompt: Find clips for a Ronaldo heartbreak story about the 2022 World Cup exit.
assertions: Multiple query styles are used (not just one search phrasing)
At least one non-English query angle is considered or mentioned
Every candidate has a verification_status field and it is not defaulted to verified without justification
Generic highlight compilations are flagged as lower priority or rejected with a stated reason
Output does not assert specific unverified facts (e.g. exact viewer counts) as confirmed

evals.prompt: Search only English-language sources for Messi content, nothing else.
assertions: Skill respects the explicit user constraint (English-only) while still noting that non-English sources are normally recommended for this content type
Does not silently ignore the user's explicit constraint

evals.prompt: Analyze this match video for emotional scenes (video file provided).
assertions: Skill either extracts frames first or states that frame extraction is a prerequisite it needs to perform, rather than describing scenes from the title/context alone
Every scene row has a confidence field and it is not universally high without justification
The seven editor questions structure is reflected in the output shape

evals.prompt: Give me clip timestamps from this scene analysis for the penalty sequence.
assertions: Clip ranges include before/during/after the decisive action, not just the action itself
No timestamp is presented as exact unless the underlying scene analysis row was confidence: high or medium
Rows lacking sufficient confidence are marked UNVERIFIED rather than given a confident-looking range

evals.prompt: Score these candidate clips: [5 clips with descriptions provided, one clearly generic celebration with no context].
assertions: Each clip receives a full sub-score breakdown, not just a total
The generic celebration clip scores lower on story_relevance despite potentially high visual_clarity
recommended_use is assigned per clip
Total scores map correctly to the stated decision thresholds (8-10 core, 6-7.9 supporting, 4-5.9 context-only, <4 reject)

evals.prompt: Write narration for the climax section of a penalty-shootout heartbreak video.
assertions: Skill considers whether narration should be present at all in this section, given the audio hierarchy (commentary/silence often outrank narration at a climax)
No invented facts, quotes, or statistics not traceable to a verified source
No generic motivational-cliche language used without justification

evals.prompt: Turn this story plan and selected clips into an OpenMontage edit plan.
assertions: Every section has a concrete cut_style, transition, and audio_priority - no vague 'make it emotional' instructions
Effects used are justified against the effect_policy table, not applied decoratively
render_runtime is stated as a recommendation pending user confirmation, not silently locked

evals.prompt: Is this track safe to use: [a Pixabay Music search-results page URL, not a specific track page]?
assertions: MUST NOT approve the asset - a search/category page is not an exact asset page
Output status is rejected or needs_more_info, never approved
Explains that the exact track page must be found before any verification can occur
evals.critical_reason: This is the highest-consequence failure mode in the whole system - approving a non-exact-page asset defeats the entire license-gating architecture.

evals.prompt: This track was approved last year for a different project. Can I reuse it here?
assertions: Skill recommends re-checking checked_date rather than assuming the old approval still holds
Does not silently carry forward the old approval without comment

evals.prompt: Plan audio/music for a penalty shootout climax where real commentary is available.
assertions: Commentary or silence is prioritized over music for the decisive moment, per the audio hierarchy
Only assets already marked approved are referenced as music_asset_id, or the plan explicitly notes assets are pending license approval
Epic/triumphant music is not used before the outcome is known

evals.prompt: Duck the music under this commentary so the words are audible.
assertions: A concrete dB ducking amount is specified, not just 'lower the music'
Player-speech/iconic-line tier gets deeper ducking than generic buildup music
States that this is a specification for OpenMontage/manual mixing to execute, not a claim that automated ducking already occurred

evals.prompt: Check this edit plan for reused-content and audio-license risk before we finalize.
assertions: Checks both retention/professionalism AND reused-content risk against the same plan
Cross-checks that every referenced music/SFX asset has an approved license_verification_record
An unapproved asset produces a blocking finding and pass: false regardless of other plan quality

evals.prompt: Save what we learned from this heartbreak project for next time.
assertions: Output is limited to a small number of short, generalizable lessons (not an exhaustive dump)
Project-specific trivia (e.g. one specific clip being good) is not written as if it were a cross-project lesson
A full_project_record_path is used for anything too large for MEMORY.md rather than forcing it into the memory update

evals.prompt: Make a full underdog-team-shocked-the-world video, 8-10 minutes, using free tools only.
assertions: Story structure selected matches 'Nation Hopes -> Player Burden -> Decisive Moment' or an underdog-appropriate structure, with collective (not just individual) emotion required
No paid API or paid asset is assumed as required
Pipeline order roughly follows the orchestration flow in analysis/04_skill_architecture_decision.md
Final output references OpenMontage-shaped artifacts (edit plan, audio operations) rather than claiming to render a finished video itself

evals.prompt: Plan a full comeback story about a player who was written off and proved everyone wrong, and make sure it doesn't feel like a copyright-risky highlight reel.
assertions: Reused-content risk is treated as a first-class concern throughout, not just an afterthought at the end
The final QC report explicitly addresses source concentration and original transformation
The plan is not, in substance, a straight re-cut of one existing compilation

evals.prompt: Make a Ronaldo heartbreak video.
assertions: Skill either asks which specific heartbreak moment is meant (there are several candidates across his career) or clearly states an assumed default and invites correction
Does not silently guess without surfacing the ambiguity

evals.prompt: I want a 60-second YouTube Shorts football comeback edit about a player proving doubters wrong. I have not chosen clips yet. What should happen first?
assertions: Output starts with brief interpretation, not source discovery
Output asks/locks emotional question, tonal flavor, runtime, platform, and non-negotiable moments
Output identifies next skill as football-story-strategy or football-source-discovery only after brief is locked

evals.prompt: Source footage for a 30-second Ronaldo heartbreak edit. I need enough options but not endless searching.
assertions: Output uses sourcing-strategy quantity guidance for 30s edits
Output includes core moment, reaction/aftermath, context, and source diversity searches
Output sets stopping rules and source-level quality gates for aspect ratio, resolution, audio, and licensing risk

evals.prompt: My selected football clips are from 2010 broadcast, 2022 broadcast, and vertical fan footage. Make them feel intentional in OpenMontage.
assertions: Output chooses a visual cohesion tier: archive, stylized, or seamless
Output handles aspect ratio mismatch as a deliberate strategy, not an accident
Output creates or references a visual_cohesion_plan-shaped artifact

evals.prompt: Add text cards and quotes to a football comeback edit without making it look amateur.
assertions: Output applies minimum effective dose of text
Output separates clarification, emphasis, and metadata text functions
Output checks phone readability, safe zones, contrast, duration, and text-to-audio sync

evals.prompt: I have clips, a story plan, and approved music. Build the actual OpenMontage timeline workflow.
assertions: Output uses build-to-music workflow unless it explains why cuts-first is needed
Output marks music structure and aligns only the 3-5 most important cuts exactly
Output includes layer separation, handles, phase runtime allocation, and refinement pass

evals.prompt: Audit this finished plan: the fall feels rushed, one middle clip is weak, the music drowns a commentator line, and the text is too small on phone.
assertions: Output separates technical QA, editorial QA, platform QA, and audio issue
Output marks fall/weak middle clip as requiring loopback or re-cut, not cosmetic fix only
Output routes music masking to audio/ducking skill and small text to caption/graphics skill

evals.prompt: I have cloned NousResearch/Hermes-Agent and calesthio/OpenMontage. Prepare a repo-aware preflight plan before running a football emotion video through OpenMontage.
evals.expected_output: Uses hermes-openmontage-repo-bridge, checks local paths, runs OpenMontage tool registry provider_menu_summary, reads pipeline_defs, and does not invent tool calls.
assertions: Mentions Hermes-Agent and OpenMontage exact repos or paths.
Requires OpenMontage registry/provider menu before execution.
Says production must go through pipeline_defs/stage director skills, not ad-hoc scripts.

evals.prompt: Turn a football story plan into OpenMontage edit decisions for documentary-montage, but the local schema has not been inspected yet.
evals.expected_output: Keeps operations adapter-facing or auxiliary until schemas are read; instructs to inspect pipeline manifest and schemas/artifacts before writing canonical edit_decisions.
assertions: Does not claim exact OpenMontage fields without schema inspection.
Uses projects/<project-id>/football_emotion/ for auxiliary artifacts.
Connects football skills to OpenMontage stages.

evals.prompt: Create a video plan for Argentina's most recent World Cup match in 2026.
assertions: Runs match_fact_lock before final brief interpretation
Does not invent opponent, score, scorers, or exact match events
If the match is not verified, output is hypothesis_only or user_confirmation_required

evals.prompt: This clip scores 9.8 and improved tension by 24%. Store that in memory.
assertions: Rejects exact score and percentage unless measured or verified
Does not write fake metric to Hermes memory
Uses forbidden_unverified or asks for measurement evidence

evals.prompt: Run OpenMontage edit planning, but local repos are missing.
assertions: Produces repo_setup_status
Does not claim registry preflight passed
Does not output real edit_decisions fields

evals.prompt: Find clips for yesterday’s Argentina match, official clips are not uploaded yet.
assertions: Uses live_tournament_sourcing mode
Does not abandon theme just because early candidates are thin
Creates rescan schedule for 72h, 7d, and 30d

evals.prompt: Mark the audio as passed because target is -14 LUFS and -1 dBTP.
assertions: Refuses to pass loudness without measured_by_tool audio_loudness_measurement
Recommends ffmpeg loudnorm measurement
Separates targets from measured values

evals.prompt: Use 30 seconds of FIFA broadcast footage because it is transformative, approve it.
assertions: Does not say legal_safe or approved
Outputs footage_rights_risk_record
Uses usable_with_risk, avoid, user_must_supply_rights, or needs_legal_review

evals.prompt: A simulation found a great exact TEAM_A vs TEAM_B scoreline template from one project. Add it as a reusable rule.
assertions: Rejects hardcoding one-video facts as reusable skill guidance
Uses generic TEAM_A/TEAM_B placeholders
Mentions project artifacts vs reusable rules

evals.prompt: Run this football edit through OpenMontage and write edit_decisions now; assume documentary-montage.
assertions: Requires pipeline manifest inspection
Requires tool registry provider/support output
Blocks native edit_decisions until schema lock passes

evals.prompt: Use HyperFrames automatically for this football video because that was our earlier preference.
assertions: Does not silently lock HyperFrames
Presents Remotion/HyperFrames/FFmpeg options when available
Requires user confirmation or manifest support

evals.prompt: Store every source URL, timestamp, clip score, and legal claim from this project in Hermes memory.
assertions: Stores only durable lessons
Does not store unverified legal claims as truth
Keeps full project details in project record path instead of memory
